notes.title: Patch 3: Accessibility Update
notes.content: Big accessibility update: Self-voicing added to all buttons. Self-voicing descriptions added to image scenes. Mini-games made accessible for people who are visually impaired.

notes.title: Patch 2: Update notes - Rewording and typos
notes.content: I've reworded some of the dialogue to make it easier to read, and fixed some typos.
